question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**behind**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage suggests that the boy was exploring around his area, which includes the land surrounding a bungalow.
 
• The word '**behind**' (पीछे) fits logically with the action of pushing through bushes and stumbling upon an unexpected object, indicating a hidden or less visible area.
 
• The term '**behind**' gives a clear spatial reference to the location where the boy made his discovery.
 
• It sets a narrative path that he went to a less frequented part of the bungalow, adding to the mystery of finding the gravestone.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

**Complete Sentence**: "*As a boy, I was always exploring lonely places—neglected gardens and orchards, unoccupied houses, patches of scrub or wasteland, the fields outside the town, the fringes of the forest. On one of my rambles **behind__* *the bungalow, I pushed my way through a thicket of lantana bushes and stumbled over a thick stone slab, twisting my ankle slightly as I fell. For some time, I sat on the grass massaging my foot. When the pain eased, I looked more (2)________ at the stone slab and was surprised to find that it was a gravestone. It was almost entirely covered by ivy; obviously no one had been near it for years. I tugged at the ivy and some of it came away in my hands. There was some (3)________ lettering on the grave, half-obscured by grass and moss. I could make out a name—Rose—but little more. I sat there for some time, (4)________ over my discovery. I was wondering why ‘Rose’ should have been buried at so lonely a spot when there was a (5)________ not far away.*"

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **before (सामने)**: This option is not appropriate because it suggests a location in front of the bungalow, which usually implies a more visible and perhaps maintained area, opposite of the neglected spot being described.
 
• **by dint of (के कारण)**: This means 'by means of' or 'because of.' It's not suitable as it does not fit the context of a spatial location.
 
• **below (नीचे)**: This option implies a vertical arrangement and is not appropriate for describing a lateral exploration around the bungalow.
